Strike the enemy three times with your heavy head, each blow more painful than the last.

<{0}_Title>Heavy Attack: Mountain Splitter</><IA>HeavyAttack</>
Dash forward with full force. Fully charge to dash further, ramming all enemies in your path.

<{0}_Title>Spell: Rockfall</><IA>Spell_QS</>
Build up full Focus to unleash this spell. Leap high and smash into the ground, causing a large Area of Damage with a shockwave of earth and stone.
5004.b:
From azure dust, a rock guai stands robust.

Transform into a rock guai, immune to all Four Banes. It builds up Might when hit.

5006.d:
<{0}_Title>Light Attack: Chop Wood</><IA>LightAttack</>
Swing the iron blade three times, building up Focus with each hit.

<{0}_Title>Heavy Attack: Blow Fire</><IA>HeavyAttack</>
With full Focus, hold Heavy Attack to unleash this skill, exhaling a scorching wave that continuously burns enemies ahead. The longer you hold, the fiercer the flames become. Dodging will not waste Focus built.

<{0}_Title>Spell: Fiery Burst</><IA>Spell_BS</>
Release this Spell to self-explode, causing area Damage and De-Transforming simultaneously.

Blow forth flames where ash is laid, for days of glory soon shall fade.

Transform into a rat guai, slashing at the enemy while blowing fierce flames at them, inflicting Scorch Bane.
Focus built up before transformation can be converted for use afterward.

5008.d:
<{0}_Title>Light Attack: Lightning Lashes</><IA>LightAttack</>
Successively lash the enemy ahead, building up Focus with each strike.

<{0}_Title>Heavy Attack: Thunderbolt Sweep</><IA>HeavyAttack</>
Successively lash the enemies around, building up Focus with each strike.

<{0}_Title>Spell: Lightning Infusion</><IA>Spell_QS</>
In transformation, this Spell can be released with full Focus.
Raise the whip towards the sky, allowing thunder to infuse you through it, charging you into a <SpellDetail_Desc_KW>Thrilled State</>.

<{0}_Title>Light Attack: Thunder Flurry</><IA>LightAttack</>
In <SpellDetail_Desc_KW>Thrilled State</>, each lash of the whip calls forth a lightning strike to assail the enemy.

<{0}_Title>Heavy Attack: Thunder Dominion</><IA>HeavyAttack</>
In <SpellDetail_Desc_KW>Thrilled State</>, raise your whip to conjure a Thunder Formation, intermittently striking enemies within its reach.
5008.b:

Transform into a horse guai, immune to Thunder Damage, inflicting Thunder Bane on the enemy.
Focus built up before transformation can be converted for use afterward.

5009.b: One somersault covers a hundred thousand miles.

<{0}_Title>Light Attack: Stormsurge</><IA>LightAttack</>

Focus built up before transformation can be converted for use afterward.

5016.d:

Alternate strikes with both tentacles, building Focus with each hit.

<{0}_Title>Heavy Attack: Tentacle Sweep</><IA>HeavyAttack</>
Swing back the tentacles to sweep attack, amassing more Focus.

<{0}_Title>Spell: Ice Sheet</><IA>Spell_QS</>

<{0}_Title>Light Attack: Snowball Fight</><IA>LightAttack</>
Initiating Light Attacks on the <SpellDetail_Desc_KW>Ice Sheet</> hurls snowballs at the enemy, dealing Frost Damage.

<{0}_Title>Heavy Attack: Avalanche</><IA>HeavyAttack</>

5016.e: Transform into Monk from the Sea.

5017.d:

<{0}_Title>Heavy Attack: Withering Winter</><IA>HeavyAttack</>
Slower but heavier, this move deals higher Damage, and builds up Focus faster. The last powerful slash deals additional Damage.

<{0}_Title>Spell: Cold Heart</><IA>Spell_QS</>
With full Focus during transformation, chant the Spell and raise the blade to summon a snowstorm and enter a <SpellDetail_Desc_KW>Cold-Hearted State</>. In this state, all blade slashes are empowered, and Dodging transforms you into clouds and mist, enabling agile retreats.

<{0}_Title>Spell: Cold Resolution</><IA>Spell_QS</>

5018.d:

Imbue the blade with eggs by self-wounding. The blade can store up to four egg stacks. Each Light Attack consumes a stack, infesting the enemy's wound with larvae.

<{0}_Title>Spell: Hive Mind</><IA>Spell_QS</>
Command infested larvae to explode, dealing severe Damage instantly. Absorb part of the hatched swarm to recover a considerable amount of Health.

<{0}_Title>Spell: Self-Detonation</><IA>Spell_BS</>
Detonate to inflict area Damage upon De-Transformation. This spell also activates <SpellDetail_Desc_KW>Hive Mind</>, causing any remaining larvae on the enemy to explode.

5019.d:

Dance with a blade of lightning, slashing repeatedly with deft finesse.

<{0}_Title>Heavy Attack: Fatal Shadow</><IA>HeavyAttack</>
Quietly charges in the shadows and executes a fatal attack upon release.

<{0}_Title>Varied Combo: Unscathed</>
Initiating a Heavy Attack during a Light Attack Combo triggers a Varied Combo. If the enemy strikes during this Varied Combo, you will be able to see through their move and counterattack, earning 1 Focus Point.

<{0}_Title>Heavy Attack: Death Trilogy</><IA>HeavyAttack</>

If followed by another Heavy Attack upon landing, another leap and slam can be performed. This sequence can be repeated up to 3 times. Once this move is executed, all Focus will be emptied.
5019.b:
Golden thunder, lightning's gift, a deadly dance both cruel and swift.

Transforms into Yellow Loong, gaining immunity to Shock and the ability to see through the enemy. Each attack inflicts Thunder Bane.

5024.d:

Unleash a rapid flurry of punches, building up Focus.

<{0}_Title>Heavy Attack: Earthshatter Slam </><IA>HeavyAttack</>
Crouch and gather strength, then leap into the air, bringing both fists down with an earth-shattering strike. If empowered by Scorch or Frost, additional effects can be inflicted on the enemy. Charging can be cancelled by Dodging without losing the Focus built up.

<{0}_Title>Spell: Monkey Mind</><IA>Spell_QS</><IA>Spell_SF</><IA>Spell_HM</> 
Build up Focus and cast a variety of Spells. Each Spell consumes a different amount of Focus based on your Spells set.
5024.b:
Between the boundless dome and mortal plains, this lone monkey stands, unyielding and unstained.

Transform into a stone monkey, gaining immunity to Shock and Poison. Absorb and convert Frost and Scorch to empower yourself. Retain access to the Destined One's Spells, and convert any pre-transformation Focus for use afterward.

5101.d:
A control spell that, with just a gesture of the finger, can bind the enemy in place. More powerful foes may break free sooner, thus caution is advised.

To ensure this spell will not be interrupted during intense combat, cast it when the opponent is exhausted, staggered, or downed.
5101.b: A simple hand gesture can bind the enemy in place.

5102.d:
A lifesaving spell that, with a simple ring drawn by the staff on the ground, grants protection from the cold and prepares for impending confrontation. Standing within the ring accelerates recovery, and the effects of drinks are enhanced.

The duration of the fire ring allows stepping out to engage in battle and returning with its effects still active. Once the time is up, the ring will vanish.
5102.b: A fiery circle drawn by the staff can provide rapid recovery within it.
5102.e: Draws a fiery circle to gain Focus and enhance Health recovery from using the gourd.

5103.d:
An offensive spell activated by slapping the character written on the palm against the chest. It considerably enhances Attack. 

While active, the character emits a continuous golden glow, binding the use of any other Spells, Vessels, Transformations, and Spirit Skills.

When confronted with formidable foes capable of restricting spell-casting, this spell may offer an unexpected advantage.
5103.b: Bind Spells, Vessels, Transformations, and Souls Skills to enhance Attack, focusing solely on martial arts to subdue enemies.
5103.e: Bind Spells, Vessels, Transformations, and Souls Skills to enhance Attack.

5201.d:
A mobility spell that leaves behind a decoy while allowing for quick dispersion into mist and escape. Useful for evading attacks or luring enemies into a trap.

Upon returning from the mist state, an Unveiling Strike can be unleashed to catch opponents off guard.
5201.b: Dispersing into mist allows for an escape and provides an opportunity to execute an Unveiling Strike.
5201.e: Transforms into white mist for a swift escape.

5202.d:
A defensive spell that transforms the caster into a rock. If the enemy strikes the rock upon the transformation, they shall be Deflected, which grants a perfect chance to counterattack.

Though the spell may seem simple, timing is crucial. Cast it too early or too late, and it won't work. Beware, enemies who possess powerful moves may shatter the rock.
5202.b: Solidify the body like a rock to parry incoming attacks.
5202.e: Instantly harden like a rock, parrying physical attacks.

5301.d:
A duplication spell: pluck a strand, chew it, and spit it into the air to create multiple Duplicates. These agile Duplicates can fight or flee and will engage the enemy if the caster is attacked.

This spell can be used to catch a breath or escape. 

However, the Duplicates are fragile and can be quickly destroyed if directly confronted by the enemy.
5301.b: Blowing strands into the air creates Duplicates to assist in combat.
5301.e: Create multiple Duplicates to assist in battle.

5302.d:
A lifesaving spell: in moments of mortal peril, this spell automatically activates. It transforms a single strand of hair from the Destined One's head into his Duplicate, which then takes his place in facing death. Simultaneously, it creates a new body for the Destined One.

The Destined One will return with full Health, but the gourd will not be replenished. 

When danger is imminent, ready this spell to be prepared for any eventuality.
5302.b: Upon nearing death, automatically activates to resurrect the Destined One.
5302.e: Upon nearing death, automatically resurrects the Destined One.

Only with sufficient Stamina can one truly excel and revel in battle.

It can strike enemies from a distance and is particularly effective against incoming attacks.

It is the best technique for achieving victory while remaining defensive.

3950.e: By day, they patrol the hills; by night, they spin their yarns. Such is the life of lesser guais. Their hard-earned yarn can be used to craft armor.

3951.e: The thread produced by an old silkworm. This can be used to craft armor.

3952.e: Slabs of leaf-shaped iron, wrested from the armor of a Yaoguai King, gleam with a cold radiance and resonate with harsh sounds. They can be used in crafting armor.

3953.e: Twisted and spun from delicate gold foil, this gold thread is a fortune in itself. This can be used to craft armor.

3954.e: The ribbon, from the celestial shuttle's delicate touch, is as light as a cloud and as vibrant as a rainbow. This can be used to craft armor.

3958.e: This is the fortitude of the mountains and the spirit of the rocks. This material can be used in crafting weapons.

3959.e: With their heart stained by cruelty and impudence, the lesser yaoguais can only forge immature cores within them. These can be used in crafting weapons.

3960.e: The sands have been smelt nine times. They can be used in crafting weapons.

3961.e: Upon the golden hill there grow the trees with hearts of gold, which can be used in crafting weapons.

3962.e: A piece of steel, forged from the unyielding essence of a spine, that never bends to the relentless tides of time. This can be used in crafting weapons.

3964.e: "Emotion is the child of uncertainty, born from the touch of experience." Once hidden inside the Buddha's head, this treasure has a secret yet to be revealed.

3965.e: "Justice lies in the lack of heart; wisdom emerges from the absence of ego." Once hidden inside the Buddha's head, this treasure has a secret yet to be revealed.

3966.e: "Seek virtue in the mundane, and tread with care. In everyday parlance, let caution guide your flair." Once hidden inside the Buddha's head, this treasure has a secret yet to be revealed.

3967.e: "Adaptability alone uncovers significance in subtlety." Once hidden inside the Buddha's head, this treasure has a secret yet to be revealed.
